From our recent Opus 5.5 pod — how Anthropic cracked down on CoT distillation attacks: Media Dario and team have actively put in fake tool calls to throw off distillers, it would be of NO surprise to see reasoning traces be filled with harmful and downright wrong choices. Every time i read them, I panic because of how dumb opus is acting, but then the output is good.

It’s time to put all the pieces together, the early tests to see how crazy it was to build a vehicle this size, the suborbital hops to practice subsonic maneuvering, the first real booster, expendable flight tests, trips to the Indian Ocean, and last flight with payload to orbit. We are one step away from the full mission, and that step is the double catch. We will try for the first time on flight 15. I don’t think and of us can promise it will work the first time, but getting here feels like a turning point. I still feel like there’s so much to review (and we will be doing that continuously between now and launch) but when I take a moment to stop and think about it, it is overwhelmingly exciting. This is the rocket that will build a human civilization on another planet. SpaceX will attempt to catch both the Super Heavy booster and Starship on the upcoming flight. If both are successful, it will mark the first time that all parts of an orbital rocket return to Earth intact. This is the critical breakthrough needed to make life multiplanetary.

Peter Thiel reveals that 4 of the 6 PayPal founders built bombs as kids: "I wasn't one of the bomb builders." It came out by accident: "It was one of those strange late-night conversations. People were like, 'So what did you do in high school?' 'I built a bomb.' 'I built one too.'" Thiel's read on what that says about founders: "There's something very extreme about the people who tend to found businesses. It's a crazy thing to start a company." And the catch: "But once you start it, you don't want to make being too crazy a virtue, because that can also destroy it." The PayPal crew went on to found or fund Tesla, SpaceX, Palantir, YouTube and LinkedIn. Extreme people, kept just sane enough. Interested in AI? Follow @AiEvolutio58513 and never fall behind.
